context.guidance: Serve every route that carries Personal Data over TLS only, and set Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite attributes on session cookies. Replace wildcard cross-origin rules with an explicit list of trusted origins. These transport and session controls are part of the safeguards Rule 6(1)(a) requires for the Personal Data they carry.

value.fix: Set the session cookie with explicit security attributes: `res.cookie('token', updatedToken, { httpOnly: true, secure: true, sameSite: 'strict', maxAge: <session lifetime in ms> });`. Also make sure every route that handles Personal Data is served only over TLS by redirecting HTTP to HTTPS and sending a Strict-Transport-Security header. Finally, replace any wildcard CORS rule (`origin: '*'`) with an explicit allowlist of trusted origins. This fix is based only on the single line provided; I did not inspect the repository, so confirm that the cookie is set over HTTPS and that no other cookies or CORS settings need the same change.
